description: Portugal earthquakes — recent seismic events recorded by IPMA for mainland Portugal + Madeira or for the Azores archipelago. Returns time, magnitude, depth, epicenter region, coordinates, and felt intensity when reported. Covers roughly the last 30 days. Example: ipma_seismic({ area: "azores", min_magnitude: 2 })

days.description: How many days back to include, 1-30 (default 7).

min_magnitude.description: Minimum magnitude filter, e.g. 2.0. Events without a computed magnitude are excluded when set.

name: ipma_seismic
title: Ipma Seismic
